title: 第21章 我说了我要改变第22章 想要解除契约也不是不可以
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
元梵话音刚落，饭桌上的空气像被冻住了。
谢云开垂着眼，指尖在筷子上轻轻摩挲，沧溟的筷子想要去夹菜却被元梵瞪了一眼不上不下的悬在半空，犹豫了很久还是默默放下了。
而刚刚温和的叫江欲来吃饭的江寻竹，现在也只是安静地坐在江欲右手边没有替她说一句话。
江欲顿时觉得自己好像中了江寻竹的圈套。
“坏了系统，江寻竹是不是就等着这一刻呢。”
系统显然没有反应过来，有些奇怪的开口。
【什么意思宿主，我有点听不懂，他不是好心叫咱们来吃饭的吗？】
江欲恨铁不成钢的在系统的脑袋上捶了一下：“你这么笨到底是怎么当上系统的？”
“他这明显就是把我叫过来被五个人审判，到时候我扛不住这么多人的压力直接松口让他们解除契约，他不就能轻轻松松走人了吗？”
听到江欲的解释，系统这才恍然大悟。
【竟然是这样！！宿主这个江寻竹还是太有心机了，我差点就被他的外表骗了。】
江欲在心里叹了口气，想着为了双修总归是要和这些道侣打好关系的，开口解释道：“今天不是来让你们做事的，我只是想来吃个饭。”
元梵立马嗤笑：“你说出来的话你自己相信吗，之前不知道是谁说不屑于吃凡间俗物。”
“现在怎么屈尊降贵的来了？”
江欲刚想开口反驳元梵，脑海里先响起了系统的声音。
【宿主你先别说话，这是真的！】
【原主一开始她觉得自己是天之骄女吃饭浪费修炼时间，后来修为停滞了，又被那个系统逼着做任务根本没空吃饭，所以在他们眼里你现在的确是‘屈尊降贵’。】
江欲扫了一眼饭桌上沉默的四个男人：“他们心里是不是恨我恨的要死。”
【……是的宿主，每一个都恨你。】
似乎是怕江欲绝望，它又开口道。

【准确地说是恨宿主原主，但你现在顶着这张脸和这具身体，这层身份恨意自然就转到宿主你身上了。】
“知道了。”
江欲在心里应了一声，知道他们这么恨自己语气倒没什么波动：“那就慢慢来吧。”
江欲也理解他们的情绪，原主这些年的压榨和冷落、把所有人冒着生命危险找来的宝物送给宗门，让这些天之骄子一个个从云端跌进泥里，不可能随便几句话就能换来原谅。
“元梵，我也说过了我要改变你不记得了吗。”
江欲大大方方坐下拿起筷子，声音里没有心虚也没有刻意讨好：“改变的第一件事，就是从今天起跟你们一起吃饭。”
元梵冷笑了一声：“改变？你？”
江欲不可置否的点点头。
“江欲，你上一次说这种话的时候，转头就把谢云开仅剩的那把防身匕首送给了内务堂的长老。”
谢云开的眼神更冷了一层，握着筷子的指节微微泛白。
“还有陆川。”元梵还在继续细数江欲的罪行，“你答应帮他寻回妖骨的线索，条件是让他去寒潭替你采千年冰莲，他在冰水里泡了三天三夜回来高烧不退，你连看都没去看一眼。”
content_en:
As soon as Yuan Fan finished speaking, the air on the dinner table seemed to be frozen.
Xie Yunkai lowered his eyes and rubbed his fingertips gently on the chopsticks. He wanted to use the chopsticks to pick up vegetables, but Yuan Fan glared at him and kept them hanging in the air. After hesitating for a long time, he silently put them down.
And Jiang Xunzhu, who had just gently asked Jiang Yu to come for dinner, now just sat quietly on Jiang Yu's right side without saying a word for her.
Jiang Yu suddenly felt as if he had fallen into Jiang Xunzhu's trap.
"If the system is broken, is Jiang Xunzhu just waiting for this moment?"
The system obviously didn't respond, and there were some strange openings.
[What do you mean by host? I don’t understand. Didn’t he kindly ask us to come for dinner? 】
Jiang Yuhen was so stubborn that he slapped the system on the head: "How on earth did you become so stupid and become the system?"
"He is obviously calling me here to be tried by five people. When the time comes I can't bear the pressure of so many people and just let them cancel the contract. Can't he just leave easily?"
After hearing Jiang Yu's explanation, the system suddenly realized.
【It turns out to be like this! ! The host, Jiang Xunzhu, is so scheming that I was almost deceived by his appearance. 】
Jiang Yu sighed in his heart, thinking that for the sake of dual cultivation, he had to have a good relationship with these Taoist companions, so he explained: "I'm not here to ask you to do anything today, I just want to have a meal."
Yuan Fan immediately sneered: "Do you believe what you say? I didn't know who said that he disdains eating earthly food."
"Why are you condescending to me now?"
Just when Jiang Yu was about to open his mouth to refute Yuan Fan, the system's voice first sounded in his mind.
[Host, please stop talking, this is true! 】
[The original owner initially felt that she was a proud daughter of heaven who wasted her training time by eating. Later, her cultivation stagnated and she was forced to do tasks by the system and had no time to eat. So in their eyes, you are indeed 'condescending'. 】
Jiang Yu glanced at the four silent men at the dinner table: "Do they hate me to death in their hearts?"
[...Yes, host, everyone hates you. 】
As if it was afraid that Jiang Yu would despair, it spoke again.
[To be precise, I hate the original owner of the host, but now that you are carrying this face and this body, this layer of identity hatred will naturally be transferred to you, the host. 】
"Got it."
Jiang Yu responded in his heart. Knowing that they hated him so much, his tone didn't change at all: "Then take your time."
Jiang Yu also understood their emotions. The original owner had been oppressed and neglected over the years, and gave the treasures that everyone had risked their lives to find to the sect, causing these proud men to fall from the clouds into the mud one by one. It was impossible to exchange for forgiveness with just a few words.
"Yuanfan, I also said I wanted to change, don't you remember?"
Jiang Yu sat down openly and picked up his chopsticks. There was no guilt in his voice or any intention to please: "The first thing I will change is to eat with you from today on."
Yuan Fan sneered: "Change? You?"
Jiang Yu nodded in disbelief.
"Jiang Yu, the last time you said something like this, you turned around and gave Xie Yunkai's remaining self-defense dagger to the elder of the Internal Affairs Hall."
Xie Yunkai's eyes turned colder, and the knuckles holding the chopsticks turned slightly white.
"And Lu Chuan." Yuan Fan continued to detail Jiang Yu's crimes. "You agreed to help him find clues to the demon bones on the condition that he go to the cold pool to collect thousand-year-old ice lotus for you. He soaked in the ice water for three days and nights and came back with a high fever. You didn't even take a look."
